methodology.marketCap: Current Yahoo price multiplied by the latest reported shares outstanding.
methodology.enterpriseValue: Market capitalisation plus total debt minus cash and short-term investments.
methodology.revenueTtm: Sum of the latest four reported quarterly revenue values.
methodology.netIncomeTtm: Sum of the latest four reported quarterly net-income values.
methodology.freeCashFlowTtm: Yahoo trailing operating cash flow minus the absolute value of trailing capital expenditures.

methodology.roic: Finviz-style ROIC = net income / (common equity + long-term debt + non-current operating lease liabilities).
methodology.current: Current ROIC uses trailing-four-quarter net income and the latest common balance-sheet date across the asset, liability and equity tables.
methodology.historical: Historical ROIC uses fiscal-year net income and matching fiscal-year asset, liability and equity statements. Capital is not averaged.
methodology.leaseAdjustment: When a separate non-current operating-lease field is unavailable, it is estimated as total liabilities - current liabilities - long-term debt - other non-current liabilities, floored at zero.
methodology.warning: This is an approximation of Finviz statement normalisation; an error of +/- 5% is possible.
methodology.roe: Net income divided by average shareholders equity.
methodology.roa: Net income divided by average total assets.
methodology.roce: Operating income divided by average capital employed.

latest.warning: Finviz-style ROIC is an estimate; an error of +/- 5% is possible.

methodology.revenueGrowth: Each annual percentage compares the fiscal year with the immediately preceding fiscal year.
methodology.netMargin: Fiscal-year net income divided by fiscal-year revenue.
methodology.fcfMargin: Fiscal-year free cash flow divided by fiscal-year revenue. Free cash flow equals operating cash flow minus the absolute value of capital expenditures.

methodology.summary: Growth metrics use CAGR where applicable; margin and ROIC summaries use period averages.
